name: Takatsuki Maria
source:
The older sister of the Takatsuki sisters, charming and with many friends.
Although she has great athletic ability, her academic performance is not so good.
She is often compared to her younger sister, which gives her some inferiority complexes, but she does care for her younger sister.
She is a member of the Kendo club.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20071013020509/http://www.assemblage.co.jp/asm/carmine/ls/char.htm]official site, archived[/url]]
